case_scope: Public procurement, privatization, asset recovery, and public-value leakage stress case

public_procurement_capture.note: BO disclosure in procurement can reveal conflicts and common ownership only when paired with procurement-integrity, supplier-integrity, open-contracting, oversight, and sanction rails.

asset_recovery_capacity.note: UNCAC Chapter V provides recovery mechanisms, but case-level outcomes must be shown.

beneficial_ownership_verification.note: Procurement BO disclosure must be verified and linked to contracts and conflicts.

capture_resistance_and_agency_independen.note: Need country-specific audit independence, civil-justice, and rule-of-law evidence.

public_common_counterweight.why: Public wealth only counts after leakage is bounded.

enforceability_remedies_capture_resistan.why: Asset recovery and procurement remedies determine whether leakage can be repaired.

evidence_debt_register.question: Which active cases count public/common wealth without procurement, conflict, and asset-recovery evidence?
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: public-value leakage addendum for sovereign fund, housing, infrastructure, and state-capacity cases

validation_notes: Stress case; intended to update public/common counterweight certification.
rev0339 procurement source-fit hardening: S183 demoted to context; OECD public-procurement instruments S487-S488 now carry direct procurement-integrity burden.
